purpose: Encode owner-informed control-author roles and stratified evaluation requirements for Joel idiolect calibration without changing any historical prediction or inventing a new authorship metric. Preserve the frozen three-author active set for historical receipts while recording newly admitted authors separately until a benchmark actually contains their scores.

owner_correction.speaker: Stian Gudmundsen Høiland
owner_correction.reported_relation: Joel reports that Stian naturally writes and thinks similarly to him, and that this resemblance was part of why they connected.
owner_correction.methodological_effect: Stian is an owner-identified stylistic near-neighbor and hard negative, not an ordinary control. Joel-to-Stian confusion alone is not clean evidence of idiolect erasure.

admitted_pending_next_benchmark.activation_rule: Become active only in a new benchmark whose source manifest explicitly includes a frozen Greg profile and held-out originals and whose score receipt contains Greg scores. Do not retroactively add Greg to historical three-author prediction bundles.
admitted_pending_next_benchmark.corpus_limit: Clean explicit-speaker source pool is feasible; final calibration profile/holdout split remains pending and the flagged 4,894-word source is excluded unless separately audited.

required_reporting_strata.members: all authors explicitly active in the named benchmark receipt
target plus all ordinary matched controls explicitly active in the named benchmark receipt
all active authors except owner-identified hard negatives

interpretation_rules: A Joel-to-Stian winner flip is not by itself evidence that Joel's idiolect was erased.
A rise in Joel-only similarity is not sufficient retention evidence when a hard negative rises more.
Removing Stian may be reported only as a candidate-set ablation, never as a way to improve the primary accuracy.
Hard-negative discrimination and ordinary-control discrimination must remain separate; do not average them into one voice-preservation verdict.
No abstention or pass threshold is authorized until original same-author and cross-author margin distributions are frozen for the register.
Historical aggregate metrics remain historically correct, but their interpretation must reflect the owner-identified near-neighbor relationship.
An admitted-pending-next-benchmark author must not be injected into an older score bundle that lacks that author's scores. Candidate-set identity is part of benchmark identity.
forbidden_claims: Stian should be removed because he is too similar
target-versus-ordinary accuracy substitutes for target-versus-hard-negative discrimination
candidate-set ablation is a calibrated operational threshold
Greg is active in historical three-author diagnostics
